data.one_liner: A collection of stepper and page indicator widgets for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides IconStepper, ImageStepper, NumberStepper, and DotStepper widgets that display progress through steps or pages. The widgets support custom shapes, effects, and line connectors.
use_when: You need a visual stepper for forms or tutorials
You want a customizable page indicator for a carousel or page view
avoid_when: You need complex state management beyond simple step control
You require integration with backend services or networking
strengths: Rich set of visual styles and animations
Easy to import and use with minimal boilerplate
Supports both horizontal and vertical layouts
weaknesses: No built‑in state management beyond activeStep
No support for async data fetching

alternatives.name: smooth_page_indicator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers page indicators with many animation options
